claims: The Masters course record is a 9-under-par 63.
Nick Price achieved a 9-under-par 63 in 1986 at Augusta National Golf Club.
Greg Norman matched a 9-under-par 63 in 1996 at Augusta National Golf Club.
The Masters 18-hole record is 63 by Nick Price in the third round of 1986.
The Masters 18-hole record is 63 by Greg Norman in the first round of 1996.
The Masters 72-hole record is 268 by Dustin Johnson in 2020 (-20).
The Masters amateur 18-hole record is 66 by Ken Venturi in 1956.
The lowest 18-hole score (non-tournament) at Augusta National Golf Club is reported to be 61 by Jeff Knox.
Jordan Spieth has recorded an 8-under-par 64 at the Masters.
Rory McIlroy has recorded an 8-under-par 64 at the Masters.
Gary Player holds the record for most consecutive cuts made at the Masters with 23.
Tiger Woods has a best round of 65 at the Masters.
The Masters course record has stood for 40 years.
No players have broken 63 in Masters tournament history.
Nick Price set the record with a wooden driver in 1986.
